row.Finding: Innovative Modified PETG Blend PolyMax™ PETG combines the best of PETG and PCTG, offering high strength and rigidity while maintaining improved flexibility and resilience. This unique balance makes it ideal for both functional prototypes and end-use parts that demand durability and reliability.

row.Finding: If you are looking to produce the strongest part (high layer adhesion), we recommend to switch off your part cooling fan. If you are looking for a high quality surface finish, we recommend to switch on your part cooling fan. Usually the best of both worlds is to leave the part cooling fan at 20%.
